question: What documents are required to renew the Certificate of Annual Mechanical Inspection and Certificate to Operate?
answer: Based on the provided sources [S1] and [S2], the documents required to renew the Certificate of Annual Mechanical Inspection and Certificate of Annual Inspection of Buildings are not explicitly stated. However, it is reasonable to assume that the renewal process may require the submission of the current Certificate of Annual Mechanical Inspection or Certificate of Annual Inspection of Buildings as proof of the existing status of the building or structure. For the specific fees associated with the renewal process, please refer to the Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of the National Building Code of the Philippines (PD 1096) as mentioned in [S3]. The exact fees for the renewal process are not provided in the given sources, but the fees for the initial issuance of the Certificate of Annual Mechanical Inspection can be found under the section "Annual Mechanical Inspection Fees" in [S3].
